concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-reporting-closing-your-fiscal-period-account-receivable-position-dashboard]] — 2026-09-15 Accounts receivable dashboard guide for Company/Merchant open positions, scheduled or historical views, distinct receivable/reserve/deposit balances, and dashboard-downloaded transaction CSV; reporting evidence, not bank receipt or accounting finality.
warnings: The source's scope and feature limits are dated; do not treat a position, Payable row, sample row, or generated report as proof of completed payout, bank arrival, or legal funds ownership.
